entries.columnsContract: `resolution_id PK, query_contract, query_schema_ref, query_input_digest, fact_kind, revision, record_set_digest, rule_revision, rule_digest, result_kind, winning_perception_id NULL, reason_code NULL, result_schema_ref, result_json, result_digest, resolved_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(query_contract,query_input_digest,revision,resolution_id)`供head精确复合FK；`winning_perception_id`显式FK；found必须有winner且reason为NULL，not_found必须无winner并具有`no_matching_record|requested_fact_absent|strongest_value_conflict`之一；`result_json`保存完整typed `PerceptionResolutionRevision`且≤`16 KiB`，digest使用统一JCS basis；current pointer/index按query digest

`PK(query_contract,query_input_digest)`；四列显式复合FK引用同一`perception_resolution_revisions(query_contract,query_input_digest,revision,resolution_id)`；head CAS与新revision/typed result在同一Resolution Commit事务；Resolution Facade只读head，不在热路径计算`MAX(revision)`

entries.columnsContract: `person_id PK, status(active|merged), current_revision, current_preference_revision NULL, current_reference_revision NULL, current_reference_projection_revision, current_reference_projection_digest, created_at_ms, terminal_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `current_revision`显式复合FK引用`people_person_revisions`；nullable Preference/Reference pointer分别显式复合FK引用对应revision表；`current_reference_revision IS NULL`表示尚无Reference revision，Commit逻辑expected `0`映射为“期望不存在”而不是存储revision 0；两个Projection checkpoint字段均`NOT NULL`，`CHECK(current_reference_projection_revision>=1)`且digest为64位lowercase hex；Person成立时以revision `1`和无Reference语义payload的digest初始化；与child表的循环FK均`DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED`；`INDEX(status,person_id)`

entries.columnsContract: `person_id FK, revision, person_status(active|merged), canonical_name, merged_into_person_id NULL, origin_kind(direct|candidate), origin_decision_id, origin_decision_digest, origin_candidate_kind NULL, origin_candidate_id NULL, origin_candidate_revision NULL, origin_candidate_payload_digest NULL, fact_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(person_id,revision)`；immutable；direct Registration保存完整Direct Decision ID/digest且Candidate列全NULL；Candidate acceptance保存Acceptance Decision ID/digest及精确Candidate revision/payload；CHECK禁止两种来源混合；Person是全局Registry，不持久化媒体`content_scope`

entries.columnsContract: `person_id FK, revision, provider, namespace, provider_key, provenance_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(person_id,revision,provider,namespace,provider_key)`；`FOREIGN KEY(person_id,revision)`引用精确Person revision；stable identity active unique

entries.columnsContract: `person_id FK, revision, preference_level, reason, origin_kind, origin_ref, committed_at_ms`
`reference_asset_id PK, person_id FK, artifact_handle_id, artifact_digest, state(active|released), created_reference_revision, released_reference_revision NULL, created_at_ms, released_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: stable业务ID由`ReferenceAssetCoordinator`在Plan前分配；`artifact_handle_id/artifact_digest`必须分别等于Decision中`artifactHandle.artifactHandleId/digestHex`；`UNIQUE(person_id,artifact_digest)`；created/released revision都显式引用同Person的`people_reference_revisions`；released不可回到active

entries.columnsContract: `reference_face_id PK, person_id FK, reference_asset_id FK, embedding_handle_id, embedding_digest, model_ref, state(active|released), created_reference_revision, released_reference_revision NULL, created_at_ms, released_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `embedding_handle_id/embedding_digest/model_ref`必须分别等于Decision中`faceEmbeddingSetHandle.artifactHandleId/digestHex/modelRef`；每个active Asset恰好一个active派生Face；Face与Asset同事务建立/释放；`UNIQUE(reference_asset_id)`及`UNIQUE(person_id,embedding_handle_id,model_ref)`；用户API不得按Face ID修改

entries.columnsContract: `person_id FK, revision, operation_kind(add_image|release_image), reference_asset_id, reference_face_id, active_asset_set_digest, active_face_set_digest, reference_set_digest, decision_digest, fact_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(person_id,revision)`；immutable；`people_persons.current_reference_revision`显式FK指向current row；Reference commit以expected reference revision CAS并保存完整active set digest，不通过扫描时间猜current；三个set digest及`fact_digest`必须严格使用`PersonReferenceRevision` nominal合同声明的唯一basis

entries.columnsContract: `registration_candidate_id PK, current_revision, current_state, proposed_name, evidence_digest, candidate_schema_ref, candidate_json, candidate_payload_digest, created_at_ms, terminal_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `candidate_json`保存Draft中精确Registration `candidatePayload`，其JCS digest必须等于`candidate_payload_digest`，且`proposed_name`以DDL CHECK匹配payload字段；payload在Candidate生命周期内immutable；JSON上限`16 KiB`且大Reference只含handle；`FOREIGN KEY(registration_candidate_id,current_revision,current_state)`显式引用revision表并`DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED`；`UNIQUE(evidence_digest) WHERE current_state='open'`；`INDEX(current_state,created_at_ms)`

entries.columnsContract: `registration_candidate_id FK, revision, state(open|accepted|dismissed|superseded), decision_origin NULL, decision_ref NULL, decision_digest NULL, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(registration_candidate_id,revision)`加`UNIQUE(registration_candidate_id,revision,state)`供head复合FK；到head的FK同样deferred；revision 1固定为open；只允许`open → accepted|dismissed|superseded`一次terminal CAS；terminal revision保存正式Decision ID/digest；immutable

entries.columnsContract: `merge_candidate_id PK, current_revision, current_state, left_person_id FK, left_person_revision, right_person_id FK, right_person_revision, evidence_digest, candidate_schema_ref, candidate_json, candidate_payload_digest, created_at_ms, terminal_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `candidate_json`保存Draft中精确Merge `candidatePayload`，JCS digest匹配`candidate_payload_digest`，四个Person热字段以DDL CHECK匹配payload refs；Person pair按ID规范化；两个`(person_id,revision)`复合FK冻结精确Person revision，payload与该snapshot immutable；Candidate current复合FK `DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED`；`UNIQUE(left_person_id,right_person_id) WHERE current_state='open'`；`INDEX(current_state,created_at_ms)`
